rv.q: From The Heart succeeds in exactly what its title promises: a joyous evening created with evident passion by a lyricist whose words continue to resonate across generations.
Overall, this was a poignant and heartwarming production which held my attention from beginning to end.
From The Heart is a very pleasant 80 minutes, although it sometimes feels like a show mounted more for friends and family rather than West End audiences.
It is 80 minutes of absolute perfection.

This version of From The Heart at the Garrick Theatre is perfectly judged: flawless vocals, comic sketches, moments of reflection, and effortless performances bring together Don Black's storied career in an evening of unbridled joy.
From The Heart is an evening of glorious cabaret that celebrates the musical love of one of our finest lyricists!
At just 80 minutes, From The Heart is a lovely little show filled with powerhouse vocals and technical excellence.
Don Black's From The Heart is a joyous celebration of a lyricist who clearly loves his craft and, in his words, never stopped dreaming to finally lead to his own West End event.
That minor quibble aside, it is a superlative evening of entertainment.
From the Heart is a lyrical, theatrical treat that deserves to be seen and heard.
It is a privilege to be in the audience, sharing the celebration with him.
